# Per diem or receipts: which meal deduction is bigger for an owner-operator?

> Free owner-operator per diem calculator: full and travel days away from home, the M&IE rate, the 80% DOT limit, per diem versus meal receipts, and the estimated self-employment and income tax saved. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
